# Training report example

Illustrative training metrics for previewing a report with two charts in one
responsive row, followed by a PNG image beside the conclusions. See
`introduction.md` and `conclusions.md` for the report prose.

The confusion matrix in `results/confusion-matrix.png` shows counts of 98 and 95
on the diagonal and 2 and 5 off the diagonal. Like the CSV, it is an illustrative
fixture, not measured data. No training workload is included.
